name: swisscode
description: Launch Claude Code with the right account, provider and model: multi-account Claude Pro/Max vault with usage limits and switching, a localhost proxy with rate-limit failover and traffic inspection, OpenRouter and custom Anthropic-compatible providers.

scripts.build: npm run build --if-present -w packages/core -w packages/adapters -w apps/cli -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --if-present -w packages/core -w packages/adapters -w apps/cli -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --if-present -w packages/core -w packages/adapters -w apps/cli -w apps/web
